text: ADHD design student here! I like the idea of this but found a few design flaws that could be improved upon: - I can't see a line or colouring showing the schedule in reference to the current time. How far am i into my block? Google agenda has this and it gives much more overview of how long things take and how much time is left - When elongating a block it does not shift every block afterwards but shows 'overlap'. I would like the option to shift everything. - In general, it would be nice to be able to drag blocks around and over each other to rearrange times. again, also when changing the length of block, this could be faster and show more overview instead of having to redo all the blocks. - Starting my first block was hard and tedious, since i didnt know where to start. maybe start with a very basic day with sleeping hours, so you can immediately see how much time is left. combining this with easy elongating and shortening would make this start even more efficient. - I would like to be able to see the timelength of an activity reflected in the length of the block itself. again, for more overview and time-understanding (for ADHD'ers like myself, this is very quickly lost. we generally don't 'feel' time as well as others, so it is nice to visualise it). Google agenda does this very well, I think. - Finally, it would be nice to have it on PC. + I do like the fact the app calculates the 'unused' hours for you. And how it moves activities into the next day automatically (like sleeping hours). the templates and tags are still a bit new for me, but also seem like very useful aspects. I hope this helps you ^-^ Good luck!
author: Kati de Jong
developer_reply: Thank you very much for your feedback and suggestions 😀 We take note of the ideas ✍ Our intention is to improve the interface progressively in successive updates 👷‍♀️ Cheers!

text: Dit is precies waar ik naar op zoek was. Een app die me helpt om meer structuur aan te brengen in mijn week! Het ingeven van je routine neemt wat tijd in beslag, maar voor mij was het de moeite meer dan waard. Wat de absolute meerwaarde voor mij is,  is dat je kan gebruik maken van gesproken notificaties door de integratie met Google Text to speach! Mijn telefoon vraagt me 's avonds terwijl ik in de sofa zit of ik de vaatwasser niet vergeten aanzetten ben, zonder dat ik mijn gsm hiervoor moet vastnemen. De app ziet er ook leuk uit, is gebruiksvriendelijk (en in het Nederlands!) en biedt veel mogelijkheden tot personalisering. En een A+ voor de klantenservice trouwens! Toen ik een probleem had, beantwoordden ze dezelfde dag nog mijn e-mail!
author: Een Google-gebruiker
developer_reply: Thank you very much for your support, Kim! ;)
